questions.question: CI vs CD (Continuous Delivery vs Continuous Deployment) khác nhau?

options.A: Delivery: auto deploy đến staging, manual approval for production. Deployment: fully automated to production
options.C: Delivery: chỉ build. Deployment: test + deploy

questions.explanation: CI: integrate code often, auto test. CD (Delivery): auto deploy to staging, human gate for prod. CD (Deployment): fully auto to prod. True CD Deployment requires: high test coverage, feature flags, automated rollback.

questions.question: Blue-Green Deployment vs Canary Release?

options.A: Blue-Green: 2 identical envs, instant switch. Canary: gradual traffic shift (5%→25%→100%)

questions.explanation: Blue-Green: zero downtime, instant rollback (switch DNS/LB). Requires 2x infra cost. Canary: gradual, catch issues early, metrics-driven. Feature flags: code-level canary. Rolling: k8s default, upgrade pods gradually.

questions.question: Golden Signals trong monitoring là gì?

options.A: Latency, Traffic, Errors, Saturation — 4 metrics đủ để characterize service health

questions.explanation: Google SRE Golden Signals: Latency (response time), Traffic (requests/sec), Error rate, Saturation (% resource used). Đủ để detect và diagnose hầu hết production issues. SLO/SLA nên dựa trên these signals.

questions.question: SAST vs DAST trong DevSecOps?

options.A: SAST: analyze source code (shift-left, early). DAST: test running application (black-box, later)

questions.explanation: SAST (Static): scan source code, fast, no running app needed, nhiều false positives. DAST (Dynamic): test live app như attacker, realistic, slower. IAST: instrument app during test (best of both). Shift-left: integrate security sớm trong pipeline.
